text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 100 people were killed in a series of massacres in Blida and Ain Defla provinces, south of Algiers.
- The government plans to create a second television channel.
- "Terrorists" kill some 75 people in new massacres in Blida and Ain Defla.
- Political parties select candidates for the local election to be held on October 23.
- Foreign reserves rose to $6.4 billion early this month from about $5.3 billion last March thanks to a tightened monetary policy.
- Police from 51 African countries meet in Algiers on cooperation against drug smuggling and other crimes on the continent.
